changelog:
VexZygisk v2.1.1

- Removed the WebUI; module status is now shown through the module action (tap the module's action in the KernelSU manager)
- Zygisk Next companion spawner deduplicated into a single exec_companion
- Fixed modules being silently skipped on filesystems that report DT_UNKNOWN (fuse, some overlays)
- Daemon no longer exits on a transient accept() error
- Dropped an unused symbol and cleared stale comments
